thread:
mira: Heads up — p95 for /v1/chat on the new latency panel is showing ~420ms, but Prometheus p95 is ~180ms. :eyes:

zane: interesting. can you paste the dashboard query or the aggregation window?

mira: sure — in the console widget it's using our rollup stream with `window=1m, merge_mode=by_endpoint`. prometheus query I checked was `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, endpoint))`

olivia: oh that merge_mode might be folding in cross-route samples from the canary. do we tag route weight anywhere?

mira: merge metadata shows route=chat and route=chat-variant sometimes, weights 0.8/0.2. the dashboard does a rollup then pctl on rolled samples, prometheus computes pctl from buckets directly.

kevin: that's the classic two-step vs single-step percentile diff. rollup-then-percentile can bias the tail if one subroute has heavier tail.

mira: yes. wondering if we should change console wording or change merge_mode default. users expect "true" p95 per endpoint.

zane: proposal: add a small badge indicating whether the widget computes percentiles from rollups or from raw histograms. UX: tooltip text + small indicator next to metric name.

olivia: agree. also add a checksum-ish sanity check: compute a lightweight sample-based p95 from a recent raw sample stream and surface delta. If delta > 10% show warning.

kevin: lightweight check idea is nice. implementation sketch: take the last 5k samples, compute exact pctl, compare to rollup pctl. cheap and fast.

mira: can we reuse the sample reservoir we already maintain for SLO checks? charts-bot: reservoir-collector has 10k sliding window per endpoint, retention 10m.

zane: @charts-bot do we have API to query reservoir counts per endpoint?

charts-bot: yes — `GET /internal/telemetry/reservoir?endpoint=/v1/chat` returns `count`, `p50`, `p95_sample`. (dev-only)

olivia: perfect. so dashboard workflow: (1) compute rollup pctl as today (2) query reservoir p95_sample (3) show both and delta in small inline pill.

kevin: fallback behaviour for low sample counts: if reservoir.count < 500, hide the delta and show "insufficient samples" tooltip.

mira: for routing policy clarity: add an annotation on endpoints that are currently being routed to variants (canary) so operator isn't surprised. maybe a small route-split icon with weights.

zane: agree. also update docs on how percentiles are computed and include the new checksum column. will file a docs PR.

olivia: quick follow up — what about quotas and alerting? some of our SLO alerts trigger on dashboard p95. we should avoid flapping. suggest alerts continue to use Prometheus histogram-based p95 for now until we confirm parity.

mira: yep let's keep alerts on prom. Dashboard gets UX improvements first. I'll open two PRs: one for the badge+tooltip+checksum UI, one for the reservoir delta endpoint (if we need any changes).

kevin: ping me on the UI PR, I'll review sizing and color semantics.

zane: I'll draft the docs blurb and include examples showing the two-step bias case with synthetic data.

mira: thanks all. created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4823 — linking the PRs there. :white_check_mark:

charts-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-reservoir-service v1.4.2 deployed to staging at 2024-11-08T14:03:00Z

mira: deployed test on staging, added widget draft to the dashboard. can everyone glance and flag any confusing wording?

olivia: looked — the delta pill makes the discrepancy obvious, good call. :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM on staging. merging UI in 30m unless objections.

zane: no objections. thanks!
